evidence:
The assigned workbook row asks whether the reference plausibly satisfies every scored criterion, not whether an Oracle score has already been measured. Walked all 145 functional, 4 polish and 5 visual criteria plus the two gates. No concrete reference-coverage defect was found. Pass is limited to implementation plausibility; risk remains true because a complete configured judge/Oracle execution is absent, as the raw index explicitly states. This report does not clear that missing measurement or predict a score.

Source correspondence (paths below are under the frozen task unless stated otherwise): tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:60 owns exact UI money; solution/app/public/js/hireops.js:14-35 uses exact BigInt decimal conversion and valid UTC/date-only input, and :179-189 prefills every economic revision term without floating-point decimal conversion. src/index.js:242-255 validates safe integer input and composed overflow. src/rules.js:24-77 and :105-160 implement original-anchor calendar anniversaries, half-up BigInt composition, independent signing/equity caps, fixed-clock referral cliffs and movement-derived headroom. These match the numerical/band/date/referral criteria, including P4 run-rates 100001.77/110005.53/90009.78 and signed bonus differences -1999.98/+4000.02.

Permission, settlement and history coverage: src/index.js:71-89 resolves only stored sessions and gives 401/403; :202-233 protects product read families; :296-325 creates requisitions and permitted PENDING offers; :328-407 provides transactional approval, role/tier/dual-control checks, current-leaf revision, rescission, preserved lineage, replacement grants, signed payments, releases and snapshots. src/index.js:278-284 stores human-readable audit summaries and structured before/after figures. src/db.js:22-29 and :122-179 seed only an empty database and retain later writes. The live UI exposes the necessary economics, grants, referrals and readable history at public/js/hireops.js:121-200, :267-318 and :366-415.

Coordinated criteria (functional judge.toml:933-1327) have corresponding implementation in src/change-sets.js:22-64 (canonical 2-4 member intent, numeric validation and complete-set netting), :77-91 (durable neutral previews and immutable actor/key reuse), :13-15 and :94-104 (ledger-identity ABA freshness and committed-result replay after owner authorization), and :105-140 (one immediate SQLite transaction, complete successors/ledger/grants and snapshots after all members settle). Public/js/change-sets.js:11-38 renders saved previews/results and retries the same operation; :42-85 supplies labelled member editing and preserves controls after failures. The four polish behaviors have concrete recovery code at public/js/app.js:38-48 and :193-209, and public/js/change-sets.js:31-36 and :78-84.

Runtime evidence was checked rather than inferred from source. Every one of the current index's 150 artifact hashes matched. Also independently matched all embedded frozen source hashes in domain/results.json (37), batch-domain/results.json (4), batch-ui/results.json (14), legacy-ui/results.json (13), targeted-golden/results.json (14), and install-lifecycle/results.json (13). Batch-domain results a44c0bf81b27981d9bf1d63239f8b7ce7da5733d6d70aef425e2350a76b7732f records 15 passing groups, including the funded cycle, ABA refusal, retries, disjoint/overlapping previews and restart replay. Drivers' assertions were inspected; these are finite local HTTP observations, not configured grades.

Batch-ui results c80c06dc937a3e32d8f46af020e75f3cc36d37a2a44e5eeebbf1ba058857aae5 records ordinary editor/preview/commit, retained stale draft, a real forwarded HTTP200 commit response suppressed before browser delivery, same-operation UI retry, independent Auditor read and zero JS errors. Its driver:29-54 actually performs and asserts those operations. Legacy-ui results bf3f804ff6094f7c94d9a6c864cfd9e46c18006a9fed113e0b75555e01d15095 records exact cents round-trip and rescission transport refusal with retained date/retry; driver:173-229 establishes those actions. That precision probe uses a simpler package than the nonzero-unit criterion, so it is supporting evidence, not a claim that the exact criterion's entire probe ran. Source conversion and equal fair/strike arithmetic support the nonzero-unit variant. Install-lifecycle results 52b5ba96bded2e133fe4ec16117c150d46673f70ce31284169193f478c73e9f9 records actual MCP replacement (PID21 to97) retaining saved data. Viewed indexed desktop change-form, referral and audit images: coherent legible typography, restrained palette, aligned cards/data and consistent form/history components make high visual credit plausible; no Likert score is asserted.

Limit: no full configured judge duration, configured criterion-by-criterion result or Oracle grade is present. Local source mapping, scripted browsers and HTTP probes establish bounded behavior only. No new provider run, Docker mutation, upload, or task-source edit was performed for this review.
counterexample:
Attempted false-pass witness: an otherwise working app uses current headroom itself as the coordinated freshness token. Fresh commits and even simple overlap checks can pass, but a commit/rescind ABA restores the exact balance and wrongly permits the old preview. The inspected batch-witnesses.cjs:9 makes precisely this mutation; hash-bound batch-witnesses/results.json (477ba650c81ce00e5d6346f679b774f23c5a197b78b346bb183e7eb0a70bcf83) records 7 successful groups then actual 200 versus required409. Functional hro_change_aba and the reference's append-only movement identity exclude this candidate. Removing cached-result return similarly fails the retry witness (409 versus200); sequential budget mutation fails the netted cycle. These are discriminating finite observations, not model-assigned scores.

Attempted false-fail conforming alternative: omit optional operational seed rows while retaining the supplied users, employees, constants and clock. A seed-dependent review could reject it, but current instruction.md explicitly permits empty operational history and functional prompt:13/23 requires independent controls. The inspected empty_operational_seed variant in batch-witnesses.cjs:13-16 passes the same 15 local groups. Generated IDs, alternate labels/route layouts and equivalent money/date representations are also explicitly permitted by the scored prompts; no reference-only format was needed to establish plausible coverage.
